summary: Streaming chat response stalls (SSE) after ~10–20 seconds for AcmeCo
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports chat streaming responses sometimes stop mid-generation; client continues waiting and the HTTP connection stays open.

Impact: User-facing chat feature appears frozen; retries cause duplicate requests.

Environment: Hosted API; OpenAI-compatible endpoint; SSE streaming enabled.

Steps to reproduce (customer): 1) POST /v1/chat/completions with stream=true 2) Receive a few data: chunks 3) Stream stops; no [DONE]; request does not complete.

Initial notes: Seems correlated with longer generations (>400 output tokens) and mobile networks.

Logs excerpt (customer paraphrase): "got first chunks then nothing for ~60s".
comments: Chloe Martin (Support): Seeing same symptom in a second workspace for AcmeCo. Do we have any known issues w/ SSE flush?
Ethan Park (Platform): Looking at api-gateway logs. I see periodic idle > 30s on the upstream stream when backend is still generating. Might be proxy buffering + heartbeat missing.
Aisha Rahman (SRE): Noticed NLB idle timeout interactions before. Are we sending keepalive frames?
Ethan Park (Platform): Added a periodic SSE comment heartbeat (:\n) every 10s when no tokens emitted; rolled to us-east canary.
Chloe Martin (Support): Customer confirmed streams no longer hang in their test after heartbeat change.
resolution: Mitigated by adding SSE heartbeat frames from api-gateway when upstream token emission pauses. Rolled out to prod us-east; monitoring for eu-west.
